dct_creator_sm: City of Milwaukee Department of City Development
dct_description_sm: This polygon data layer represents 190 City of Milwaukee neighborhoods defined through the Department of City Development's Milwaukee Neighborhood Identification Project of 2000. The boundaries consider subdivisions, streets, physical barriers, community participation, housing, historic areas, and residents' opinions. They are not official City boundaries, are not maintained continuously, and are not intended to match neighborhood-organization boundaries. The source shapefile is projected in NAD27 / Wisconsin South (EPSG:32054).
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
